place.name: King Chulalongkorn Memorial Building
place.description: The King Chulalongkorn Memorial Building (Swedish: Kung Chulalongkorns minnesbyggnad; Thai: พระบรมราชานุสรณ์พระบาทสมเด็จพระจุลจอมเกล้าเจ้าอยู่หัว), also known as the Thai Pavilion (Swedish: Thailändska Paviljongen), is a Thai pavilion (sala Thai) in Utanede, Ragunda Municipality, Sweden. It was built to commemorate the 1897 visit of King Chulalongkorn of Siam to the area during his visit to Sweden, where he met King Oscar II of Sweden and Norway.
